items.t: Trump to hold Ohio rally amid governor’s race controversy
items.x: President Trump's is expected to continue his 'campaign blitz' Wednesday with yet another Ohio rally; the visit comes amid growing controversy surrounding the state's gubernatorial race.

items.t: Ex-FBI officials charged in the case about Hunter Biden's laptop are due back in court
items.x: Two FBI agents charged with lying to Congress about investigations into Hunter Biden are due back in court for a preliminary hearing Tuesday.

items.t: Gainesville teen arrested after sheriff’s office, FBI find explosive-making materials, officials say
items.x: A 15-year-old was arrested Monday after investigators found chemicals and files related to explosives at his Gainesville home, the Alachua County Sheriff’s Office said.

items.t: Man arrested after DUI with 9-year-old child in car
items.x: A man was placed under arrest after he was driving under the influence with his child in the car on Monday night.

items.t: Starbucks announces return of Red Cup Day

items.t: What to do if your iPhone Duo screen breaks
items.x: Apple's first foldable phone is here, but some users are reporting cracks on the inner display. Here's what to do if your iPhone Duo breaks.

items.t: More than 4.3 million toothpaste tubes recalled, including children’s brands
items.x: More than 4.3 million tubes of fluoride toothpaste, including several products marketed to children, are under a nationwide voluntary recall because of manufacturing problems, the Food and Drug Administration said.

items.t: Cornell faces questions over dorm assignment for student disciplined in sexual assault case
items.x: Cornell University says it will review how it handled the co-ed housing assignment of a student who returned to campus after serving a suspension connected to an alleged gang rape at a fraternity house.

items.t: Mother who traveled to Las Vegas on a work trip arrested after unsupervised child was injured and hospitalized, deputies say
items.x: Deputies say a 9-year-old was injured by a falling dumbbell while four children were home alone. The children’s mother was later arrested.

items.t: What led to 6 alligator attacks in Florida, including two fatalities?
items.x: Researchers classify shoreline fishing as low risk, but this deadly encounter shows even routine outings can turn dangerous.

items.t: Breast cancer survivor faced hair loss during chemotherapy and reclaimed her identity
items.x: Lisa Steinhauser, a breast cancer survivor, opens up about the emotional toll of chemotherapy-induced hair loss and how she reclaimed her identity and strength.

items.x: Federal law enforcement agents have searched a Beverly Hills home as part of an investigation into Eric Swalwell, who resigned from Congress amid a wave of sexual misconduct allegations.

items.t: New York flight attendant accused of scamming Palm Coast senior out of $25K arrested at Miami airport
items.x: A New York flight attendant was arrested at Miami International Airport after investigators accused her of taking part in a sweepstakes scam that cost a 75-year-old Palm Coast woman about $25,310.

items.t: Tennessee inmate serving life for murder stole a truck after slipping through the prison fence
items.x: Authorities are searching for a man convicted of murder who escaped from a Tennessee prison and stole a truck from a nearby farm.
